lines: I've gotten used to even a frenzy like the end of the world
and mistake this everyday life for peace
Rambling coaster, shaken around as I ride
what is it I must never lose sight of?
Swallowed up by the notion of egalitarian fundamentalism
even my heart is just so on and so forth
I hate it, I love it — I've got to say it out loud
otherwise I'm hardly different from a doll
The crowds moving through the evening streets
look happy, or look lonely
the contrast leaps across the staff lines
and becomes song and rhythm
Marmalade and sugar song
Peanuts and bitter step
So sweet and so bitter I feel dizzy
Let's keep the party going, aiming south-southwest
It'll turn into a night that ends up astonishing the whole world
I feel great — a chain reaction, reflecting on and on
Tossed about by the sound logic of probability-based rationalism
does our music sink into being just a tool?
Face this way, don't turn your back on me
that may not count as sound logic, but
after the festival music fades
some people stay worked up, some end up bursting into tears
it's probably the same for everyone
but the moment I put it into words, it's clumsy beyond saving
It's the best — a sugar song
Happiness is a bitter step
Project the reason we can't die right there
Even if we wish we could hold on to it
tomorrow still comes at constant speed
But once the weather forecast in my head
has been updated
Someday, even if the frenzy holds its breath
Someday, even if sound logic loses its meaning
Feeling song and step
just keeping on playing
becomes the proof of what makes us who we are
Q.E.D!
Marmalade and sugar song
Peanuts and bitter step
Project the reason we go on living right there
North-northeast falls behind us — that distance makes me proud
Let's keep astonishing the whole world
Marmalade and sugar song
Peanuts and bitter step
So sweet and so bitter I feel dizzy
Let's keep the party going, aiming south-southwest
It'll turn into a night that ends up astonishing the whole world
I feel great — a chain reaction, reflection
Goes on — one spectacle passes, one trouble passes, another spectacle begins
